---
brand: onepager/_brand.yml
format:
  typst:
    output-file: cv.pdf
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 1.6cm
      y: 1.5cm
    fontsize: 9.5pt
    include-in-header: assets/typst-helpers.typ
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    dev: "ragg_png"
---

```{r setup}
#| fig.keep: "none"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.keep = "none")
source("R/cv_functions.R")
cv <- create_cv()
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
print_pdf_header(cv)
```

```{r intro, results='asis'}
print_text_block(cv, "intro")
```

This CV is rendered from the aboutme data package; the online version and a one-page CV are at [www.lse.de/cv.html](https://www.lse.de/cv.html).

```{r band, results='asis'}
print_band(cv)
```

```{r work, results='asis'}
print_section(cv, "work_experience")
```
